title: 1-minute bookkeeping fix: a personal buy on the business card
label: 1-minute fix

lines: Maya bought groceries on the business card.

items.s: It's on the bank statement, so it stays in the books.
Not an expense. In an S corp, ask how to book it.
Your future self will thank you.

cta.sub: We'll DM you the cleanup checklist.

captions.instagram:
Bought something personal on the business card? It happens. Here's the 1-minute fix:

✔️ Don't delete it. It's on the bank statement, so it has to stay in the books.
✔️ Recategorize it as owner's draw (sole owners and most LLCs), not as an expense. S corp owners: ask your bookkeeper how to book it.
✔️ Add a note that says personal.

The IRS says personal, living and family expenses are generally not deductible, and keeping separate business and personal accounts makes records easier.

Books already full of these? Our Bookkeeping Cleanup Checklist walks you through the catch-up.
